newsitem.title: USA: Metal Management completes MacLeod buy.
newsitem.headline: Metal Management completes MacLeod buy.

text.p: Metal Management Inc said Thursday it completed its acquisition of California-based MacLeod Group of Cos, a group of five scrap metal recycling companies.
Terms were not disclosed. The MacLeod Group had aggregate gross revenues of more than $35 million in 1996.
"This entry into the California market is a major move forward for Metal Management," said chairman T. Benjamin Jennings, who said MacLeod fits its strategy of regional consolidation.
MacLeod's founder, Ian MacLeod, joined Metal Management's board of directors and will remain as chief executive officer of the MacLeod Group.
